comment.body: The report already establishes that Settings can be opened only after a workaround, that clicking “New key” produces no visible result, and that no devices appear. The attached ZIP was rejected for an oversized entry, and the later CET comment does not identify which process state changed. Please restart PowerToys, reproduce the New key failure once, and submit `/bugreport` immediately; also state whether the Mouse Without Borders process/service is running, whether any key appears locally, and exactly what CET setting was changed and then restored. These facts distinguish a UI command problem from key generation or network discovery.
